Dear Sir.
Your attention is drawn to this office letter dated 19.12.2014
and 02.02.2015.
It was requested to send the analysis of
court cases where adverse orders have been passed.
Itwas also requested to send the details of pending cases on the
basis of age-wise pendency in the prescribed format.
Further vide letter dated 03.02.2015
it was requested to send one page note duly signed by the advocates along with the
reasons of success/failure in all the disposed Legal matters.
However the above mentioned information
is not being submitted by the field offices on regular basis. CPFC has
directed that the one page note in respect of disposed cases be collected from the counsels within 10 days of the
pronouncement
of the order and sent to Head Office. It has been further directed that wherever the counsel fails to
submit the note. the field offices need to ensure that payment of the counsel be regulated accordingly.
Therefore it is once again requested to send the one page note on disposed of cases for placinq before EC. CST along
with details of pending EPFAT cases for apprising CPFC in the following format for each of the office under your
jurisdiction
:-

pending
